description: This file defines a static class 'ChatFormat' that provides methods for formatting and manipulating chat XML documents, specifically for initializing documents, adding posts, finding posts, replacing text in posts, and enforcing a maximum number of posts. It encapsulates logic for handling chat schemas in XML format.

classes.name: ChatFormat
classes.description: A static class providing methods for formatting and manipulating chat XML documents, including initialization, post management, and schema enforcement.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes an XML document with schema information if it's empty, setting creation timestamp and origin.

methods.name: GetPostsContainer
methods.description: Retrieves the container element that holds all post elements within the chat XML document.

methods.name: MakePost
methods.description: Creates a new 'post' XML element with provided GUID, user, timestamp, and text.

methods.name: FindPost
methods.description: Finds and returns a post element by its GUID within the document.

methods.name: ReplaceText
methods.description: Replaces the text content of a given post element.

methods.name: EnforceLimit
methods.description: Ensures the number of posts does not exceed the maximum limit; removes the oldest if necessary.
